goal: Prevent identical address announcements relayed across peers from falsely inflating address multiplicity
Account for initial time penalties during address freshness checks
reviewability: Author agreed to address a refresh ordering bug in the next push
agreement: Support because it reduces inflated address counts on onion and i2p nodes (stratospher)
Verified by testing that duplicate announcements inflate multiplicity without the fix (frankomosh)
Concept approval for simplifying multiplicity logic by dropping the update interval (danielabrozzoni)
Objection: genuinely newer announcements get blocked when refresh fires (taki-abedesselam)
Objection: relayed announcements over an hour newer cannot add buckets (fametrano)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes address multiplicity inflation caused by duplicate announcements from multiple peers
Impact is minor hygiene rather than eclipse protection since adversarial peers can simply alter timestamps
